title: Direct correlation between open-circuit voltage and quasi-fermi level splitting in perovskite solar cells: a computational step involving thickness, doping, lifetime, and temperature variations for green solutions
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,15618-15629
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01868D, Paper
Open Access

Muhammad Umar Salman, Muhammad Mehak, Umair Ali, Ghulam Moin U Din, Shahid M. Ramay, M. Younis, Shahid Atiq
In this study, a 1D perovskite-based solar cell was simulated using COMSOL, incorporating CH3NH3GeI3 (organic in-organic hybrid) as an absorber layer, SnO2 as the electron transport layer (ETL), and Cu2Te as the hole transport layer (HTL).
